battle.name: 越南戰爭
battle.brief: 越南戰爭自1959年起在東南亞熱帶丛林展開，美國與北越正規軍及游擊隊的衝突升級。雙方广泛使用包括UH-1「休伊」直升機在內的多型軍備，UH-1在兵力投送與近距離空中支援中扮演關鍵角色，提升了地面部隊的機動性與火力。

kit.name: UH-1「休伊」直升機
kit.history: UH-1為美軍首款大批量使用的戰術通用直升機，主要負責兵員與物資運輸、空中偵察及近距離支援任務，並成為越戰標誌性空中平台。

countries: 本文以1959年為觀察起點，把戰爭寫到1975年4月30日。最初兩個主要交戰主體，是17度線以南的越南共和國及其軍隊，以及17度線以北的越南民主共和國與越南人民軍；在南方，越戰同盟席及人民解放武裝力量與前者交戰，並在不同年份更換名稱。法國在1959年仍有駐扎南部與中部的部隊，主力雖陸續撤回，顧問與後勤人員卻留到1964年；美國顧問和援助當時也已深度介入。1965年美軍地面部隊進入後，澳大利亞、加拿大、紐西蘭、南韓、泰國與菲律賓先後加入。蘇聯與中國支援北越及南方解放軍，但供應來源不同：北越以蘇制武器為主，南方軍大量使用中國製裝備。老撾王室軍與寮國游擊隊交戰，美軍和北越軍也跨境作戰；柬埔寨王國軍先後面對赤色高棉與北越軍。1973年美國停止直接作戰後，越南共和國在失去美軍直接地面掩護後，仍須對抗越南人民軍與南方解放軍，直至政權垮台。
countriesEn: This account takes 1959 as its starting point and carries the war through April 30, 1975. The two principal belligerent sides at the outset were the Republic of Vietnam and its armed forces south of the 17th parallel, and the Democratic Republic of Vietnam and the Vietnam People's Army north of it; in the South, the Viet Cong and the People's Liberation Armed Forces fought the former under a variety of names over the years. France still had troops in South and Central Vietnam in 1959. Although the main body withdrew in stages, advisers and logistics personnel remained until 1964, while U.S. advisers and aid were already deeply involved. After U.S. ground forces entered in 1965, Australia, Canada, New Zealand, South Korea, Thailand, and the Philippines joined in turn. The Soviet Union and China supported North Vietnam and the southern liberation forces through different supply channels: North Vietnam relied mainly on Soviet weapons, while southern units used large quantities of Chinese-made equipment. The Royal Lao Army fought Pathet Lao, while U.S. and North Vietnamese forces also operated across the border; Khmer Republic forces faced the Khmer Rouge and North Vietnamese forces in turn. After the United States stopped direct combat in 1973, the Republic of Vietnam, having lost the direct ground protection of U.S. forces, still had to fight the Vietnam People's Army and the southern liberation forces until its government collapsed.
people: 1959年12月30日至1960年1月3日，Tạ Quang Ứng率領一個解放軍營級分隊，以埋伏和火砲截擊以南越軍第2師骨幹組成的特遣隊；美國顧問Robert R. Martin在現場協助南越指揮官。這場戰鬥把越南共和國政府與軍隊、越戰同盟席和美國顧問放在同一條指揮鏈上。1963年11月2日吳庭艷在政變中遇刺身亡，阮文紹隨後成為軍方的核心政治人物。北方方面，武元愷以國防部長身分主持多次大規模攻勢，文進勇長期負責總參謀部的作戰與後勤，阮志清則把中央指導接到南方戰區。美國方面，William Westmoreland於1964年至1968年指揮駐越美軍司令部，Creighton Abrams自1968年接掌並延續作戰支援。1975年4月30日，最後一任越南共和國軍總司令Nguyễn Văn Biên接受投降，終止了這個政權的直接軍事指揮體系。
peopleEn: From December 30, 1959, to January 3, 1960, Tạ Quang Ứng led a Liberation Army battalion-level element that used ambushes and artillery against a task force formed around the ARVN 2nd Division; U.S. adviser Robert R. Martin assisted the South Vietnamese commanders on the ground. The battle placed the Republic of Vietnam government and armed forces, the Viet Cong, and the American advisers within the same command relationship. Ngo Dinh Diem was killed in the coup of November 2, 1963, after which Nguyễn Văn Thiệu became the dominant political figure among the military. On the northern side, Võ Nguyên Giáp directed several major conventional offensives in his capacity as defense minister; Văn Tiến Dũng handled operations and logistics for a long period as chief of the general staff; and Nguyễn Chí Thanh connected central direction with the southern theater. On the American side, William Westmoreland commanded Military Assistance Command, Vietnam, from 1964 to 1968, and Creighton Abrams took command in 1968 and continued combat support during the changing war. On April 30, 1975, Nguyễn Văn Biên, the last commander in chief of the Republic of Vietnam Armed Forces, accepted surrender and ended that government's direct military command structure.
kits: 雙方裝備並非整齊地按年份換代，以下型號在1959年底以前均已列裝，卻一直使用至後期。美軍與南越軍常見步槍、衝鋒槍和機槍包括M1 Garand、M1卡賓槍、M1928A1湯普森衝鋒槍、M3A1、M1919A4、M2重機槍及1957年開始服役的M60；火炮包括M101 105毫米榴砲、M1 155毫米榴砲與M115 8英寸榴砲，裝甲車輛則有M3 Lee、M24 Chaffee、M47、M48 Patton以及M35、M54系列卡車，無線電包括1959年投入使用的AN/PRC-25。航空裝備有C-47、B-52、F-100、F-101、A-1 Skyraider、A-4 Skyhawk、C-130、UH-1、H-34、H-21與HH-43，其中UH-1在1959年才開始交付，卻很快改變了機動作戰。北越空軍使用An-2、MiG-17、MiG-21與Il-28，並部署1957年已列裝的SA-2防空導彈；北越及南方解放軍的輕武器包括莫辛納甘M1891/30、SKS、AK-47、DP-27、1955年列裝的PKM與ZPU系列。裝甲車有T-34/85、SU-100、PT-76，火炮則有85毫米SD-44、122毫米M-38、152毫米ML-20及82毫米迫擊砲。彈藥因此必須分開供應7.62×39、7.62×51、7.62×54R、.30-06與.50 BMG等口徑，以及105毫米、155毫米高爆彈和黏稠燃料武器。
kitsEn: The opposing forces did not replace their equipment in neat chronological blocks. Every model listed here had entered service by the end of 1959 and remained in use during later phases. Common U.S. and South Vietnamese small arms included the M1 Garand, M1 Carbine, M1928A1 Thompson, M3A1, M1919A4, Browning M2 heavy machine gun, and the M60 general-purpose machine gun, which entered service in 1957. Artillery included the M101 105 mm howitzer, M1 155 mm howitzer, and M115 8-inch howitzer. Armored vehicles included the M3 Lee, M24 Chaffee, M47 and M48 Patton tanks, and M35 and M54 trucks; communications included the AN/PRC-25 radio introduced in 1959. Aircraft and helicopters included the C-47, B-52, F-100, F-101, A-1 Skyraider, A-4 Skyhawk, C-130, UH-1, H-34, H-21, and HH-43. The UH-1 only began deliveries in 1959 but quickly altered the conduct of mobile operations. North Vietnamese aircraft included the An-2, MiG-17, MiG-21, and Il-28, while the SA-2 air-defense missile, fielded in 1957, was also deployed. Light weapons used by northern and southern liberation forces included the Mosin-Nagant M1891/30, SKS, AK-47, DP-27, PKM, fielded in 1955, and ZPU-series guns. Armor included the T-34/85, SU-100, and PT-76; artillery included the 85 mm SD-44, 122 mm M-38, 152 mm ML-20, and 82 mm mortars. Logistics consequently had to separate ammunition for 7.62×39, 7.62×51, 7.62×54R, .30-06, and .50 BMG weapons, as well as 105 mm and 155 mm high-explosive shells and napalm munitions.
tactics: 1959至1964年，南越軍主要執行搜索、清剿、護路與營地防衛。阿巴戰鬥中，解放軍先選擇狹窄道路與先頭車隊，再以火力封住隊首和隊尾，使由多個單位組成的南越特遣隊難以一次投入全部兵力。1965至1968年，美軍把搜索與殲滅作戰結合空襲、砲兵、地面縱隊及直升機空降；德浪河谷戰役暴露了分散營級單位協調不足，也顯示直升機在缺乏完整協同與掩護時容易受擊。此後美軍增加空中近距支援、彈藥投送與基地防衛，但小規模交戰仍很難轉化為對北部補給體系的永久破壞。1968年春天攻勢同時打擊軍事指揮所、機場、火砲陣地、彈藥庫與交通節點，部分據點一度失守又被奪回，軍事成果有限，卻迫使美軍加速由搜索與殲滅轉向清剿並守住地區。1969至1972年，越南化逐步交由南越軍承擔主要地面任務，美軍以火箭砲、戰術航空、B-52、邊境地雷與港口封鎖支援；1972年廣治失守、安祿受攻後，越南人民軍發動春季攻勢，美軍則以Linebacker及Linebacker II反擊。1973年之後，戰爭沒有因停火而消失，越南人民軍以常規師作戰的比重迅速增加，1975年再以大規模砲兵、裝甲縱隊與步兵協同向南部推進。
tacticsEn: From 1959 to 1964, South Vietnamese forces emphasized searches, clear-and-hold operations, route protection, and base defense. At Ap Bac, the liberation force selected a narrow road and the leading vehicles, then used fire to seal the head and rear of a South Vietnamese task force composed of several units, preventing it from deploying all its strength at once. From 1965 to 1968, the United States combined search-and-destroy operations with air attacks, artillery, ground maneuver, and helicopter insertions. The Battle of Ia Drang exposed weaknesses in coordination among dispersed battalion-sized units and showed the vulnerability of helicopters operating without fully integrated support and protection. American forces subsequently increased close air support, ammunition delivery, and base defense, although small engagements rarely produced permanent destruction of the northern logistics system. The 1968 spring offensive struck military command posts, airfields, artillery positions, ammunition depots, and transportation nodes. Some positions were temporarily lost and retaken, so the military gains were limited, but the offensive forced the United States to accelerate its shift from search-and-destroy toward clearing and holding territory. From 1969 to 1972, Vietnamization transferred more ground missions to South Vietnamese forces, while the United States supported them with rocket artillery, tactical aviation, B-52 strikes, frontier mines, and interdiction of ports. After the loss of Quảng Trị and pressure on An Lộc in 1972, the North Vietnamese launched a spring offensive, prompting the American Linebacker and Linebacker II responses. The war did not disappear after the 1973 cease-fire. The People's Army of Vietnam rapidly increased its reliance on conventional divisions and in 1975 advanced with massed artillery, armor columns, and coordinated infantry.
data: 資料上要先區分背景與本文起點：越南共和國軍於1955年11月1日正式成立，本文則採1959年為觀察點。可核對的主要硬日期依序是：1959年12月30日至1960年1月3日第一次阿巴戰鬥；1964年8月2日第二次東京灣事件，8月7日美國國會通過東京灣決議；1965年3月2日滾雷作戰開始，3月8日首批美國海軍陸戰隊地面部隊抵達峴港；1965年11月14日至18日德浪河谷戰役；1968年1月30日春季攻勢展開；1972年12月18日至29日第二次Linebacker行動；1973年1月27日巴黎和平協議簽署，最後一批美國地面戰鬥部隊於3月29日撤出；1975年4月30日西貢陷落。美國國防部資料顯示，駐越美軍人數在1968年末達到約543,400人的高峰，1969年度授權上限降為475,200人。南越軍武裝兵力則常以1964年約15萬、1968年約85萬估算，這是補充後的編制兵力，不等於同時作戰人數。北越軍與南方解放軍的人力數字因來源和統計方法差異較大；各來源又分別計算陣亡、受傷、失聯與被俘，因此本文不列出任何未經確定的精確總傷亡。
dataEn: The record must first distinguish background from the chosen starting point. The Republic of Vietnam Armed Forces was formally established on November 1, 1955, while this account uses 1959 as its observational beginning. The principal verifiable dates are as follows: the First Battle of Ap Bac ran from December 30, 1959, to January 3, 1960; the second Gulf of Tonkin incident occurred on August 2, 1964, and the U.S. Congress passed the Gulf of Tonkin Resolution on August 7; Rolling Thunder began on March 2, 1965, and the first U.S. Marine ground troops landed at Da Nang on March 8; the Battle of Ia Drang took place from November 14 to 18, 1965; the 1968 spring offensive opened on January 30; Linebacker II ran from December 18 to 29, 1972; the Paris Peace Accords were signed on January 27, 1973, and the last U.S. ground combat troops departed on March 29; and Saigon fell on April 30, 1975. U.S. Department of Defense data show American strength in Vietnam reaching a peak of approximately 543,400 around the end of 1968, followed by an authorized ceiling of 475,200 for 1969. The armed strength of the Republic of Vietnam Armed Forces is commonly estimated at about 150,000 in 1964 and 850,000 in 1968, although these figures represent expanded establishment strength rather than troops present at the front. Estimates of northern and southern liberation forces vary considerably by source and counting method. Records also classify killed, wounded, missing, and captured personnel differently, so this account gives no unverified exact total casualties.
cause: 長期衝突的制度背景可追溯至1954年7月21日簽訂的日內瓦協議。協議結束法國在印度支那的主要作戰安排，只在17度線建立臨時軍事分界，沒有解決越南政治統一與軍隊部署問題。1955年南越軍成立後，南部武裝組織由零星襲擊轉向營級攻擊、地方據點與縱深補給；北越則透過訓練、命令、武器與人員指導支援。1959年成立的第559運輸團把道路維護、汽車運輸、通信與後勤倉庫整合，胡志明小道由戰術通道發展成持續運作的高強度補給系統。蘇聯和中國分別維持外部供應，美國則增加顧問、武器、顧問與空運能力，希望南越政府能獨立承擔地面作戰；但南越軍在情報、統一指揮及後勤方面仍有缺口，1963年政變後的軍事掌權局面又使指揮關係更加複雜。1964年8月2日，美國海軍巡邏艦馬多克斯號在北部灣遭到北越海空力量攻擊；關於當晚是否另有第二次襲擊，後來仍有爭議，但這起事件及船員傷亡促使國會迅速通過東京灣決議。美國政府其後採取分階段擴大空襲、部隊與顧問規模的政策，避免立即投入大規模地面入侵，同時試圖維持南越政權與區域承諾。外部大國競爭、南越領導不穩、邊境山區的補給通道，以及北越將南部戰爭納入常規戰準備的能力，因而共同推動了持續升級。
causeEn: The institutional background of the conflict can be traced to the Geneva Accords signed on July 21, 1954. They ended the principal French military arrangements in Indochina and established only a temporary military demarcation along the 17th parallel; they did not resolve Vietnamese political reunification or the deployment of armed forces. After the Republic of Vietnam Armed Forces was established in 1955, southern armed organizations moved from isolated attacks toward battalion-sized operations, local bases, and deeper logistics. North Vietnam supported them through training, direction, weapons, and personnel. Group 559, formed in 1959, integrated road maintenance, motor transport, communications, and depots, turning the Ho Chi Minh Trail from a tactical route into a continuously operating high-intensity logistics system. The Soviet Union and China maintained external supply, while the United States expanded advisers, weapons, airlift, and eventually troop commitments in the hope that the South Vietnamese government could conduct ground operations independently. The South Vietnamese armed forces nevertheless had gaps in intelligence, unified command, and logistics, while military rule after the 1963 coup made command relationships more complex. On August 2, 1964, the U.S. patrol ship USS Maddox was attacked by North Vietnamese air and naval forces in the Gulf of Tonkin. Whether a second attack occurred that night remains disputed, but the incident and the injuries suffered by the crew prompted Congress to pass the Gulf of Tonkin Resolution rapidly. The United States then adopted phased escalation of air strikes, forces, and advisers, avoiding an immediate large-scale ground invasion while seeking to preserve the South Vietnamese government and regional commitments. Rivalry among the external powers, instability in South Vietnamese leadership, the supply routes through the border highlands, and North Vietnam's ability to incorporate the southern war into conventional planning therefore drove the continuing escalation.
impact: 1965至1968年的美軍、南越軍及盟軍作戰，在湄公河三角洲、中部高地與北部邊界取得一批戰術成果，卻同時迫使北越把後方與補給縱深移得更遠。基地、雷達、砲兵與長距離空運體系不斷擴張，使作戰重心由單次襲擊延伸至持續供應、維修、燃料與防衛。1968年春季攻勢雖未推翻南越政府，卻顯示後方指揮所、空軍場、彈藥庫和交通節點均可同時受攻，也迫使美軍改採更穩定的清剿、守據與護路方式。1972年美軍在Linebacker行動中封鎖北部港口、攻擊鐵路與儲油設施，部分進口被迫改走其他鐵路和陸路，但供應沒有完全中斷，越南人民軍仍可調整運輸。巴黎協議簽署後，美軍直接地面參戰逐步結束，北越則因外來援助風險下降而增加常規師、火砲與突擊部隊的比重。越南化使南越軍人數與自主作戰次数上升，也把原先由美國承擔的運輸、砲兵協調、防空與維持任務逐步移交。旋翼機的大量使用提高了部隊機動，也使飛行指揮、起降點防衛、維修與連續運作成為各軍共同面臨的問題；到1973年之後，戰爭的成敗已不再取決於美軍是否大規模投入地面部隊，而越來越多取決於南越軍能否以殘餘的美軍支援維持縱深防衛，以及北越軍能否集中兵力形成連續攻勢。
impactEn: The operations conducted by U.S., South Vietnamese, and allied forces from 1965 through 1968 produced tactical gains in the Mekong Delta, Central Highlands, and northern border regions, but they also pushed northern bases and logistics deeper. The continuous expansion of bases, radar networks, artillery systems, and long-range airlift extended the conflict beyond isolated attacks into the sustained provision, maintenance, refueling, and defense of forces. The 1968 spring offensive did not topple the South Vietnamese government, but it demonstrated that command posts, airfields, ammunition depots, and transportation nodes could be attacked together. It also forced the United States toward more stable clearing, garrison defense, and route-protection methods. During Linebacker in 1972, U.S. forces interdicted northern ports and attacked rail facilities and oil depots, forcing some imports onto other rail and overland routes. The flow was not completely interrupted, and the North Vietnamese army was still able to reorganize its transport. After the Paris Accords, direct U.S. ground participation gradually ended, while the risk of losing external supply became lower, encouraging the North Vietnamese army to increase the proportion of conventional divisions, artillery, and sapper units. Vietnamization expanded South Vietnamese numbers and the frequency of operations conducted without American ground forces, but it also transferred transport, artillery coordination, air defense, and sustainment tasks that the United States had previously carried. The extensive use of rotary-wing aircraft increased mobility while also making flight command, landing-zone defense, maintenance, and continuous support common problems for every army. After 1973, the outcome depended less on whether the United States would mount another large ground war than on whether South Vietnamese forces could sustain a defense with residual American support and whether the North Vietnamese army could concentrate enough troops to create a continuous offensive.
result: 1973年1月27日簽署的巴黎協議沒有替兩個越南交戰政體制定永久政治安排；它要求美國停止直接戰鬥並撤出部隊，把停止空襲與俘獲交換相連，越南共和國則繼續存在。1973年3月之後，美國的直接戰鬥部隊離開，越南人民軍獲得更大的常規部隊集結與補給空間，越南南方解放軍則把游擊戰與正面作戰並行。1974年9月，越南人民軍第二師奪回廣治，顯示停火線已不能限制北越軍在南部的主要攻勢。1975年3月，越南人民軍發動全面攻勢，相繼在昆嵩、安祿與春祿方向作戰；南越軍依靠據點、火砲與最後階段的美國航空支援抵抗，但中央下令從中部高地撤退後，縱深迅速縮短。4月29日，越南人民軍第308師進入獨立宮；4月30日，Nguyễn Văn Biên接受投降，越南共和國軍的指揮體系終止。1976年7月2日，南北以社會主義共和國越南的名義完成正式統一。直接美國地面戰在1973年已經結束，越南共和國則在美軍撤退後又獨力維持兩年；1975年4月30日才出現最終軍事結果，這個結果是越南人民軍與南方解放軍取得南部控制權，並使越南重新統一。
resultEn: The Paris Accords signed on January 27, 1973, established no permanent political arrangement between the two Vietnamese belligerent governments. They required the United States to cease direct combat and withdraw its troops, linked the halt of bombing to prisoner exchanges, and left the Republic of Vietnam in existence. After March 1973, U.S. ground combat units departed, giving the People's Army of Vietnam more room to concentrate conventional forces and receive supplies, while the southern liberation forces continued combining guerrilla operations with conventional warfare. In September 1974, the 2nd Division of the People's Army of Vietnam recaptured Quảng Trị, showing that the cease-fire line no longer constrained its principal offensives in the South. In March 1975, the People's Army launched a general offensive and fought in the Kontum, An Lộc, and Xuan Lộc areas. South Vietnamese units resisted from fortified positions with artillery and the last available American air support, but after the central command ordered a withdrawal from the Central Highlands, the defense depth collapsed rapidly. On April 29, the 308th Division of the People's Army of Vietnam entered the Independence Palace. On April 30, Nguyễn Văn Biên accepted surrender, ending the command structure of the Republic of Vietnam Armed Forces. On July 2, 1976, North and South were formally unified under the name Socialist Republic of Vietnam. Direct American ground combat had ended in 1973, but the Republic of Vietnam continued the war alone for two more years. The final military outcome came on April 30, 1975, when the People's Army of Vietnam and the southern liberation forces gained control of South Vietnam and brought about reunification.
